self_review: The new section follows the runbook's existing pattern: a short intro paragraph, then a numbered how-to list.
Sentences check against ASD-STE100 (writing-style.principles): short, active voice, one instruction per numbered step, no filler or hedges.
Every command in the section (`mise run lint`) is literal and runnable as written; ran it live and captured its real output as evidence.
No other doc indexes or cross-references the runbook's section headings, so no other file needed an update.
This task documents an existing procedure; it makes no new process, scope, or design ruling, so process.rulings-to-file has nothing to home here.
Commit is a single, focused Conventional Commit; the repo's commit-msg hook (no-trailer check plus commitlint) accepted it on the first try.
